inferenceResults.rationale: Declaring the new preview and its LiftrBase dependency does not itself narrow an existing REST or SDK contract; concrete v9 changes are assessed through their declarations and candidates.
The roleName and entities optionality changes are already represented by deterministic candidates, and the oldEntities compatibility member does not add another independent breaking contract.
The removed legacy CloudAccountProperties fields are represented by deterministic candidates; the new company and roleAssignmentsOnCcaCreate properties are additive.

intentAssessments.title: ArmResourcePatchAsync is not recommended for SDK-compatible PATCH
intentAssessments.expected: Use an explicit PATCH request model with ArmCustomPatchAsync so the REST and generated SDK request contract are intentional and consistent.
intentAssessments.actual: CloudAccounts.update changes from an explicit ResourceUpdateModel-based custom PATCH to ArmResourcePatchAsync<CloudAccount, CloudAccountProperties>, and the generated SDK parameter changes from CloudAccountUpdate to CloudAccount.
intentAssessments.rationale: The official ARM operation guidance explicitly warns that ArmResourcePatch visibility analysis is AutoRest-specific and is not replicated in SDK generation. The deterministic SDK comparison confirms the resulting public method and request-model break.
intentAssessments.gap: The official ARM operation guidance explicitly warns that ArmResourcePatch visibility analysis is AutoRest-specific and is not replicated in SDK generation. The deterministic SDK comparison confirms the resulting public method and request-model break.
